tags.description: Shell, sand beach. Sheltered, undeveloped. Large forested upland site reached from N end of beach along shell trail. Suited to small groups. Additional beach camping except at Springs. Attractive.
tags.name: Cattle Islands (BCMT)

tags.description: Moderate gradient cobble, rocks beach. Boulders. Long carry at low water. All-tide beach camping on pebble. Summer Springs to 5.0 m leave small beach area. Upland sites possible with brushing. Year-round creek, waterfall, pool. Attractive. View.
tags.name: Goletas Waterfall (BCMT)

tags.description: Protected steep cobble, gravel beach. Spacious, semi-exposed camp on level gravel bar. Some protection from NW. Water at creek. Attractive. Road nearby.
tags.name: Songhees Crees (BCMT)

tags.description: Protected pocket gravel beach at high water, large smooth rocks at low water. E aspect. Small sloped beach margin sites. Dense vegetation in upland. Marginal site but suitable for emergency or transitory use.

tags.description: Beach. Some protection. Informal site secondary. Level site that has seen previous use.
